title: observability-weekly-2026-10-26
content:
Weekly Observability Notes - 2026-10-26
Owner: Maya Thompson
Attendees: Maya, Ethan, Lena, Noah, Priya, Oliver, (standup notes include a few async updates from SRE)

High-level summary:
- Focus this week on rolling out the new per-model cost telemetry pipeline and associated dashboards for Redwood Dedicated.
- Tracing work addressed two latency hotspots introduced by the new batching router; partial mitigations are live in staging.
- Cost telemetry dashboard v1 deployed to staging; awaiting finance review and perf tuning before GA.

Wins / Completed:
- Cost telemetry ingestion: all trace->cost joiners now produce model_id tags. End-to-end test pipeline green (ENGOBS-412).
- Dashboard: per-model token cost + 95th latency panel added to Observability > Cost dashboard. Initial thresholds defined (alerting disabled until after finance review).
- Runbook: added a short runbook for the new batching-router latency incident with quick mitigation steps (disable batch pooling, revert kernel selection).
- Tracing: added a low-overhead sampling rule for dedicated hosts to capture tail latencies without overloading traces storage.

Ongoing / In progress:
- Tracing instrumentation for KV cache hits/misses (Lena): 60% complete. Need to finalize tag names to match metrics pipeline. Blocking: consensus on tag schema (see ENGOBS-429).
- Cost ETL perf tuning (Ethan): high cardinality model variants are causing slow joins in the enrichment step. Experimenting with a pre-aggregation step to keep join set small. ETA: 10/29.
- Dashboards: UX iteration with Finance (Priya): finance requested an exportable CSV view and clearer attribution of infra vs model costs. Priya to sync with product.
- Alerts: Noah is drafting a new set of alerts for sudden per-model cost spikes. Proposal will include dynamic baselining and cooldown windows to prevent noise.

Incidents and Postmortems:
- 2026-10-23, Increased tail latency on dedicated-east-1 (brief, ~7 minutes). Root cause: batching router change caused rare kernel fallback path to execute frequently under certain request size mixes. Partial rollback reduced occurrences.
  - Actions done: immediate canary rollback, enabled defensive sampling, flagged kernel-selection telemetry for higher sampling (owner: Mason from serving-runtime).
  - Follow-up: permanent fix requires kernel-selection fallback guard (PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/278).

Decisions / Notes:
- We agreed to keep alerts for cost spikes in 'monitoring' mode (no pager) until the CSV export and finance sign-off are complete.
- Sampling rates: temporary increase of tail sampling from 1% to 5% on dedicated clusters for next 72 hours to gather more signal for the kernel-selection issue.

Meeting notes / standup snippets:
- Maya: landed the trace->cost joiner changes, monitoring ingestion latency. Need help from infra to add index on model_id in the enrichment DB.
- Ethan: running pre-agg job prototypes; early numbers show 3x faster joins but need to validate accuracy.
- Lena: will push KV cache tracing RFC by Wednesday; want to keep tag names consistent across traces and metrics.
- Priya: finance sync scheduled 10/28; prepping slide deck and sample CSV output.
- Noah: alert proposal ready for review; wants to test with synthetic spike generator. Oliver to help create workload.

Action items (owner - due):
- Add DB index for enrichment job on staging (Infra - 2026-10-28).
- Finish KV cache tag RFC and circulate for review (Lena - 2026-10-28).
- Finalize pre-aggregation prototype and run accuracy tests (Ethan - 2026-10-29).
- Finance review of dashboard and export example (Priya - 2026-10-28).
- Set up synthetic spike test harness and run alert firing test (Noah + Oliver - 2026-10-30).
- Close loop on kernel-selection PR and schedule rollout window (Maya + Serving Runtime eng - 2026-10-30).

Blockers / Risks:
- High-cardinality model variants causing ETL slowdowns - risk to timely GA of cost telemetry. Mitigation: pre-aggregation and TTLs on enrichment join set.
- Potential alert fatigue if cost spikes are noisy when we increase sampling; we will run alert in monitor mode first.

Notes to self / informal TODOs:
- Ping infra about DB index and check if adding an index will affect write throughput for enrichment pipeline.
- Save a copy of finance CSV example to Confluence page before the 10/28 sync.
- Reconcile metric/tag naming across traces/metrics to avoid manual joins in SQL queries.

Related tickets/PRs to watch:
- ENGOBS-412: cost telemetry end-to-end test (done)
- ENGOBS-429: KV cache tracing schema (in progress)
- PR #278: kernel-selection fallback fix (serving-runtime)

Next week focus (10/30-11/05):
- Stabilize cost telemetry and get finance sign-off so we can enable alerts (non-pager) and prepare a GA runbook.
- Complete KV cache tracing and ship to staging.
- Close kernel-selection fix and run extended canary across dedicated clusters.

Appendix: quick links
- Staging dashboard (cost): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/obs-costs/staging
- Trace sampling dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/trace-sampling
- Runbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=5423317

----
End of weekly note.
